title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
summary: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to acquire Hugging Face, a popular open-source AI hub, for $12.9 billion. This move would strengthen Nvidia's dominance in AI infrastructure while enabling its return to the cloud computing market.
content: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face, the popular open-source AI hub, for $12.9 billion in a move that would let Nvidia both protect its chip empire and jump back into the cloud business.

zh.title: 英伟达即将收购拥抱脸公司
zh.summary: 英伟达据报已同意以129亿美元收购热门开源AI中心拥抱脸。此举将加强英伟达在AI基础设施中的主导地位，同时使其能够重返云计算市场。

title: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation
summary: Instinct, a one-year-old AI startup, has raised $350 million at a $2.5 billion valuation, demonstrating rapid investor confidence in the emerging AI sector. The funding reflects intense competition for promising AI ventures, though the startup faces scrutiny over privacy concerns.
content: The startup is only a year old but it has already generated a massive amount of hype (and money) while also spurring privacy concerns.

zh.title: 走红的AI初创公司Instinct以25亿美元估值融资3.5亿美元
zh.summary: 成立一年的AI初创公司Instinct以25亿美元的估值融资3.5亿美元，展现了投资者对新兴AI领域的快速信心。这笔融资反映了对前景光明的AI企业的激烈竞争，但该初创公司面临隐私问题的审查。
